dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Symmetrical, gradual geometric narrowing from the mid-back toward the posterior peduncle region.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Uniform medium-to-dark slate grey across the visible dorsal area.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, diffuse darker grey clusters distributed across the mid-dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient shifts between slightly varying grey tones.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A prominent, thin, high-contrast longitudinal linear mark visible along the cranial-caudal dorsal axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A single, elongated longitudinal scar or structural ridge centered on the upper dorsal surface.
